mapper.select: SELECT b.*, d.device_name, d.device_no, u.real_name AS user_name, a.expected_return_time FROM borrow_record b LEFT JOIN device d ON b.device_id = d.id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON b.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN borrow_apply a ON b.apply_id = a.id WHERE b.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND status IN (1, 3) AND return_time IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO borrow_record(apply_id, device_id, user_id, borrow_time, status, remark) VALUES(#{applyId}, #{deviceId}, #{userId}, #{borrowTime}, #{status}, #{remark})
